scope: Internal reference construction cached-session core; host/API/editor integration pending
behavior: Explicit numeric writes remain separate from evaluation.
Detached cached definition, geometry, state and diagnostics retain no mutable resolver input.
Successful edits increment the version and renew a 60-second lease; failed edits preserve both.
Changed private workspace token, expiry, cancellation and disposal retire the cache.
Apply publishes the exact cached proposal synchronously once and prevents reentrant changes.
Rejected publication retains the cache; detached publisher mutation cannot alter it.

requiredHostIntegration: Authoritative model/source binding independent of selection-only API revision changes.
API revisions/retries, context mutation, lock/resource checks and exact source resolution.
Host registry, competing previews, timer/display ownership, cancellation and API disposal.
Atomic identity/dependency/history publication and shared GUI/editor commands.

limitations: The private token is a caller contract, not a public request revision or scene fingerprint.
The core owns no GPU resources or timer; the host must release its display on expiry.
Publication must be synchronous and atomic; arbitrary callback side effects cannot be rolled back here.
No public-MCP session, full editor or native lifecycle acceptance.
